config.rate_definition: share of R, G, B samples whose LSB carries a payload bit
config.scatter: carriers.base.scatter_order with a fixed key (the password, for the encrypted variant)
config.encrypted_note: stego.hide() with a password: AES-256-GCM body behind a 14-byte STGA header; salt and nonce are random per run

detectors.name: signatures
detectors.description: Scans the first few KB of the LSB stream in common orders for this project's STGA header, common file magic numbers and readable text.

detectors.name: chi_square
detectors.description: Chi-square attack on pairs of values (Westfeld & Pfitzmann 1999) over growing prefixes of the sample stream; detects sequential LSB embedding.

detectors.name: sample_pair_analysis
detectors.description: Sample pair analysis (Dumitrescu, Wu & Wang 2003): estimates the fraction of samples carrying LSB payload per channel.

detectors.name: rs_analysis
detectors.description: RS analysis (Fridrich, Goljan & Du 2001), mask [0,1,1,0] on groups of 4 horizontal pixels: estimates the fraction of samples carrying LSB payload.

detectors.name: histogram_pairs
detectors.description: Single-image even/odd histogram pair imbalance against shifted control pairs; detects flattened pairs (random payload) and the text-payload comb.

detectors.name: lsb_randomness
detectors.description: Entropy, monobit, runs and byte-uniformity tests plus spatial correlation of the LSB plane; flags random-looking (encrypted or compressed) payloads.
